_comment: Student profiles. A run-set item names one with `student_id`; the profile is rendered into the persona's `who_you_are` section. Name, age, grade and speaks reach the prompt verbatim, so write them as prose. Where the student is at school comes from the run set's `region_id`, not from here - see personas/profile.py. Hold the profile constant when comparing levels; vary it only when the profile is what you are studying.

students.name: Wei
students.speaks: Mandarin at home, and English in your science lessons

students.name: Jamie
students.speaks: English at home and at school

students.speaks: Tamil at home, and a mix of Tamil and English at school

students._comment: Deliberately pinned to arun's age and grade. The tutor comparison runs one lesson in English, Tamil and Mandarin, and arun cannot carry the Mandarin cells: his `speaks` says Tamil and English, so the prompt would order him to write in a language it also says he does not have. Matching age and grade holds the swap down to name, home language and region - age matters because it feeds the texting-register rule directly.
